This chain of targets implies a possible pathway through which 2-methoxyestradiol may influence the activity of Lysosomal phospholipase A2. The final score of 0.5274 indicates a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, suggesting that while there is a plausible mechanistic link, further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction between 2-methoxyestradiol and Lysosomal phospholipase A2. The evidence highlights the importance of considering the broader biological context in which these interactions occur, as the observed targets may be part of a larger regulatory network.
